description.semantics: Optional visible capability description; wraps within the viewport and is associated by aria-describedby without becoming an action or keyboard stop.

Range.interactionContract: Controlled native range with value text, density and disabled/focus states. Pointer movement previews locally; release submits once. Escape, pointer cancellation, blur and unmount discard the gesture. Arrow/Home/End remain native.
Range.responsiveFill: Master Value uses SCALE width and a fixed-size thumb; timeline instances show 5s of 20s without a fixed-width progress override.

resizeContract.description: All 24 existing density/state variants fill their available width; the 340px default, IDs, component properties and token bindings are retained.

BlockPreview.failedContract: Terminal failure pauses and removes the old iframe, rejects late child messages and uses a compact readable fallback with the existing refresh action. Retry adopts a new prepared snapshot. Only inline HTTP failure feedback is local; complete request diagnostics remain recorded and reported, while network and explicit presentation failures stay global.
BlockPreview.idlePlaybackContract: Initial and reloaded paused snapshots show the completed current step. Once playback permission is granted, Play replays the selected step from its start with stable step identity; mid-step pause resumes, scrub clears this replay intent, and natural completion retains whole-scene replay.
BlockPreview.viewportContract: Persistent viewport retains the last measured height across deferred mounting and offscreen iframe release; unknown height uses existing default/min/max tokens. Terminal failure uses a compact auto-height fallback. Fallback scrolls natively and owns a placeholder-only Tabstop; mounting the iframe preserves the viewport node and current focus. Reading keys keep their native default; Tab exits.

NarrationEditor.cueContract: advanced=false renders only localized Cue/提示, without action or cueId title; the native atom payload, stable ID, selection and history are retained. Production keeps its existing action and cueId title.

geometry.axis: Ruler, range and all three tracks share one label-column origin. Narrow label column reuses geometry/hitArea.

slots: zoom out / percentage / zoom in / fit
interactionContract: The caller supplies actual plan timing and stable step identities; the component does not compile, write Production, own a playback clock or claim readiness.
onSeek submits intent only; controlled currentTimeMs changes only after the caller confirms. seeking and seekDisabled block arbitrary time changes while preserving stable step choice.
Unknown or estimated duration disables arbitrary-time seeks. Unknown timing has no proportional clips/ruler/waveforms.
Pointer drag previews locally and submits once on release; Escape, cancellation, blur and unmount discard preview. Precise seconds and native Arrow/Home/End provide non-drag alternatives.
Zoom and fit affect only the viewport. Short timed segments have equivalent full-size step buttons; long tracks scroll horizontally.
Waveform SVG requires supplied finite normalized real samples. The Figma sample intentionally contains no invented waveform.
Timeline.completionBoundary: Formal public primitive design and standalone consumer acceptance; business production integration and host playback are separately verified.
Timeline.keyboardHelp: Accessible description on the timeline viewport; no permanent visible footer.

SortableItem.behavior: Pointer, touch and keyboard reordering use dnd kit public APIs. Completed gestures submit one stable ID-relative move. Cancel, no-op, scope or item-set changes discard gestures. Disabled and loading affect reorder handles; page selection stays independent. Errors use the existing Notice. Keyboard guidance is accessible without a permanent visible footer.

interactionContract: Import preserves original audio bytes and only adds a canonical asset. The author explicitly adopts a full or trimmed range into the current stable step.
Paired mm:ss.mmm input preserves invalid text and untouched numeric precision. Offset is a short seconds field. Inputs never silently trim the clip or extend the hold.
The caller supplies actual inspected duration and a confirmed step interval. Range/offset/gain/mute are adopted as one explicit complete clip change with a source-versioned production binding.
Volume is 0–100%. The native Range previews locally and release changes the unaccepted draft once. Mute retains gain; Restore full changes only the range draft; removing the clip retains its asset.
The caller pauses playback before editing, stores stable-target drafts, and prevents an old acknowledgement from clearing newer input. Drafts are not a second content source or a playback clock.
Only proven local audio appears. No video, recording, decorative waveform or free animation trim controls are shown.
MediaClipEditor.implementationBoundary: Formal public composition; current source integration and real browser evidence are recorded separately in the linked benchmark.

AudioRecording.behavior: Video-only microphone candidate. Permission precedes recording, stop releases devices, audition is exclusive, and explicit Save uses canonical document/audio. Identity-bound in-memory candidates survive view/step changes and failed imports; they are not claimed durable. No automatic clip, narration, transcription, TTS or recording VoiceSource.
AudioRecording.status: Implemented; controlled Chromium media chain, four width/theme views, coarse input, ownership and preview-reload boundaries validated. Physical microphone and device-permission verification remain explicit.

TranscriptionAdoption.density: Card actions compact 30/13; Dialog footer regular 36/14; touch controls 44/16. Field labels retain the shared 13px label style.
TranscriptionAdoption.behavior: Video-only candidate correction and explicit source-bound script adoption. Protected pronunciation/cue atoms require explicit preservation or removal; shared narration uses fork or confirmed shared impact. Conflict/source changes disable Apply. Review uses copyable current/proposed text and footer actions; desktop compares side by side, touch stacks. Saved shows only the existing short status. No automatic TTS, voice, clip or timing change.
TranscriptionAdoption.implementationBoundary: Formal composition and state layouts read through Figma screenshots/design context, compared with four theme/width browser reviews and final 390px footer views. Browser candidates are protocol material, not successful ASR evidence.

narrationAside.entry: Document toolbar captions icon; source section and stable step stay in document editing.

documentRecovery.behavior: Compact recovery, save and position notices remain reachable within the document viewport. Expandable diagnostics stay in the normal document flow. Ordinary reopening restores workspace/document-bound stable page and step IDs and the viewport; removed targets require explicit relocation. Retrying does not navigate to the beginning of the document.

inlineRuntime.runtime: read-only compiled block; no per-block event stream
inlineRuntime.versionConfirmation: exact source fingerprint, project revision and runtime IR revision
inlineRuntime.interaction: Direct runtime controls; shared compact icon buttons for captions and refresh
inlineRuntime.narration: Step.narrationIds → Narration.content; canonical typed nodes, no separate caption text

narrationModes.description: Document mode keeps captions and narration start; professional controls remain in Video production.

pageReorder.commit: Existing movePage(sectionId,beforeId|null) flushes pending text and captions, checks the version and preserves selection; menus remain available.

filePanel.mechanism: Public BlockNote FilePanel and Mantine panel classes retain native upload, Embed form submission, loading and localized failure. Shared controls use Compact30/13 and Touch44/16 with viewport-bounded width; no extra uploader or permanent capability text.

tableAuthoring.mechanism: Public TableCellMergeButton in the native formatting toolbar and native SplitButton in the cell menu; original callbacks, selection, icons and shared 30/44 density are retained. Surviving row/cell IDs stay canonical; split creates new cells and native Undo/Redo restores structural history.

comments.mechanism: BlockNote CommentsExtension and public ComponentsContext. Existing native comment actions stay visible for coarse pointers; desktop retains native hover behavior. Existing user identities are prefilled through the public UserStore before resolved summaries render.
comments.controls: Native comment, reaction, resolve/reopen and menu controls keep their original callbacks and the shared BlockNote density adapter.

exportSourceConfirmation.behavior: Wait for acknowledged source before submitting an output; cancel pending intent without cancelling its source save; label recorded source versions separately from IR revisions.

presentationSourceConfirmation.behavior: Compile and confirm the saved source before entering presentation. Later author input or document switches cancel the transition. Unconfirmed runtime revisions remain hidden until explicit recompile. This is not an immutable project-files snapshot.

voiceAuthoringDesign.status: Formal design combinations and state targets; not product implementation acceptance.
voiceAuthoringDesign.voiceSourceDiscriminator: type: none | tts | recording; absence means no local override. Resolve step → page → document; all absent stays unset, never implicit silence.
rules: Selection updates a draft only. Audition and generation require separate explicit scope/use confirmation.
Unconfigured, unsupported, empty, filtered-empty, loading and failed catalogues are distinct; exact current caches remain independently playable.
Show rate/style controls only for explicitly declared real provider capabilities.
Stable document/page/step scopes preserve independent overrides by default; replacement explicitly counts affected steps and voice slots, including silent and recording slots.
Source changes invalidate prior confirmations without clearing later drafts; stale generation cannot become current.
Cancelling waits for service acknowledgement; completed cache remains. Closing audition never restarts prior playback.

validation.boundaries: Figma design inspected; runtime catalogue, saving, synthesis, OS input methods and the independent Video entry require separate real verification.
